chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Quiet weddings, an 11-year first marriage and traveling in separate cars
summary: Buck's wedding was on the Q.T., so was Bubbles' first, which lasted eleven years; the couples traveled by car separately and the marriages did not affect the act.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Before we get into that. Was there any special type of wedding ceremony for Buck's wedding? Did you perform in it? Did he perform in it? Was it a large wedding, a small wedding?

Quietly. Quiet. Q.T. Quiet. Q-U-I-E-T. Quick. The marriage was a silent marriage, silent marriage, okay? No publicity, no nothing. Mine was the same way. Oh, no, I had mine in church. That's right, I had mine in the church. I was in New York -- no, no, no, this one I married, it was
on the Q.T., too. Mine was Q.T. But my second marriage was in the church.
However, the first marriage went down. There was difficulty. There was difficulty.
So now there's four of you. There's Buck and his wife and you and your wife.
That had nothing to do with the act. Nothing.
Nothing to do with the act, but you're all traveling together.
No, he traveled his way, I traveled mine. We get there the best way we can each way. He now traveled in his car, I traveled in my car. We don't go on the same train or nothing like that. The wives
they're traveling with us in the cars, okay? So where we go to now?
